rationale: Raw combinational mux of clk_a/clk_b selected by unconstrained primary input mode_i (line 4) clocks sink; no glitch-free structure, so a select change can create a runt/extra edge. Class follows the workflow table (clock muxes are Clock and reset interaction), not clock_intent_inventory as the author stated. CDC-019(a) and CDC-031 (primary-input select) both diagnose the mux. CDC-002 is dropped: it fires for any logic-generated root, including safe ones, and so does not diagnose this defect. Spec caps both pinned rules at WARNING Unresolved, so the best spec-conformant outcome is an unresolved-bad tally, not Established detection. Caveat: sink reaches no output and synthesis may remove it, so the hazard exists in the RTL clock structure but not as an observable port failure. Raw rst_n release, recovery/removal and physical timing remain external obligations outside this label.

labels.rationale: An unconstrained mode_i directly switches unrelated clock levels. Changing select while levels differ creates an extra edge or truncates a pulse; no glitch-free switching structure exists.

A raw mux switches asynchronous clocks using unconstrained mode_i. Changing select while the leaves differ can generate an extra/runt edge at sink. No glitch-free switching structure or mode constraint exists.
